text.en: AI Path Planning, No Missed Spots

text.zh: 边缘感应，支持无框玻璃

applications.zh: 家庭, 汽车, 办公室, 厨房

description.en:
Our window cleaning robots use intelligent path planning and powerful suction (2800Pa) to clean glass surfaces safely and efficiently. Perfect for high-rise windows, glass walls, and large glass surfaces that are hard to reach.

Features include remote control and APP control, automatic edge detection, fall-prevention with safety rope, and 25-minute runtime with 65dB quiet operation. The smart water spray system delivers just the right amount of moisture for streak-free cleaning.

We support OEM/ODM customization including colors, branding, and packaging. MOQ 200 units, production lead time 25-35 days.
description.zh:
我们的擦窗机器人采用智能路径规划和2800Pa强力吸附，安全高效地清洁玻璃表面。非常适合高层窗户、玻璃幕墙和难以触及的大型玻璃表面。

功能包括遥控器和APP控制、自动边缘检测、安全绳防坠落，以及25分钟续航和65dB静音运行。智能喷水系统提供恰到好处的水量，实现无水痕清洁。

我们支持OEM/ODM定制，包括颜色、品牌和包装。最小起订量200台，大货交期25-35天。
